description: Analyze videos to extract transcript and structured fields for each segment in the video.

config.segmentationDefinition: Segment the video into the finest possible minimal procedural units. One segment = exactly one concrete action or operation (do not combine multiple actions). If multiple actions or phases are present, split further; treat preparatory actions, main actions, and concluding actions separately. Each segment must contain exactly one atomic procedural step.

SegmentId.description: Unique identifier for the video segment.

StartTimeMs.description: The start time of the segment in milliseconds.

EndTimeMs.description: The end time of the segment in milliseconds.

procedure.description: 実施内容を番号付き手順形式（1. から開始）で日本語出力
